# requireTextStyle

<link-summary>Returns the value as a text style, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireTextStyle() — Returns the value as a text style, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireTextStyle(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Expected a TextStyle object."
): GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.TextStyle;
```

An Apps Script service object has no constructor a script can test against, so the guard reads the tag the object reports for itself: `value.toString() === "TextStyle"`. A plain object that reports the same tag passes too, which in practice means a test double.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                                 | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :-------------------------------------------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                   | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Expected a TextStyle object."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.TextStyle` — the same value, typed as a text style.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                      |
| :------------------------- | :----------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | the value is not a text style. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
const style = SpreadsheetApp.newTextStyle().setBold(true).build();

requireTextStyle(style); // => style
requireTextStyle({}); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireTextStyle(null); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
